welcome.title: Welcome to the course workspace
welcome.description: This is where you'll follow {{courseTitle}}, review your progress and move through the main tools for each lesson.

sidebar.description: The left panel gives you the full syllabus, the status of every lesson and the notes area where you can save ideas, key excerpts and reminders while you study.

tools.title: Activities and questions

soflia.title: SofLIA supports you inside the course

ready.title: Ready to begin
